title_en.v1.title: 5 Morning Habits: Stretch, Drink Water, Wash Eyes, Oil Pull and Choose a First Meal
title_en.v1.reason: All five habits are explicitly named and explained in the transcript.

search_queries: morning stretch water oil pulling routine

detailed_summary.v3.overview: The video proposes five habits for the first hour after waking. First, it recommends a natural full-body stretch for about a minute, describing it as a way to loosen joints and increase circulation. Second, it recommends drinking plain water before tea or coffee, suggesting hot, warm or room-temperature water and later summarizing the amount as roughly two to four glasses according to comfort. Third, it advises filling the mouth with water and splashing the eyes 15–20 times after using the bathroom, framing this as relief from screen-related dryness, redness and strain. Fourth, it recommends oil pulling with one tablespoon of cold-pressed coconut, sesame or mustard oil for 10–20 minutes, followed by brushing and tongue cleaning. Fifth, it places special emphasis on the first food of the day and gives different Ayurvedic suggestions according to the goal or condition, such as seasonal fruit for general health and several condition-specific foods or herbal preparations. The speaker suggests leaving about 30 minutes before regular breakfast. The routine is presented as taking roughly 30 minutes in total. A sponsored skincare segment follows. The structure is easy to apply, but several physiological and disease-specific claims are stronger than the supplied evidence supports.
